title: Brightwater post-mortem
text:
# Brightwater — what happened (post-mortem)
**Date:** 2026-04-14 · **Attendees:** Karandeep, Bhavin, Dhaval, Pranav

- Agreed settlement with Brightwater last week (letter to be signed). $9,000 credit against future invoices. Mark Delaney "happy to move on".
- Timeline (Pranav): milestone 2 slipped ~3 weeks. Root cause = Brightwater gave us warehouse access 19 days late (their security review). We have the emails showing we asked 4 times.
- Didn't matter. Contract had no exclusion for client-caused delay. Their UK lawyers claimed LD of $18,400 under the delay clause.
- Calloway Stern bill for the back-and-forth: $14,200. Their advice was basically "settle, English courts, you signed it".
- Karandeep: "I signed it at the airport. English law, uncapped LD — I didn't even see it." Contract was with AtliQ Inc.
- Dhaval: he checked scope vs proposal before sending it over, nothing else. "I assumed you'd read the legal bits."
- Bhavin asked whether any other contracts have the same problem. Nobody knew. Karandeep: "I think the rest are ok."
- Pranav: team lost ~2 weeks of senior time to the dispute paperwork.
- Agreed: no more signing on the phone.

title: Internal contract queue meeting
text:
# Internal — contract queue (ad-hoc, 22 Sep)
Present: Karandeep, Bhavin, Dhaval, Jay

Called because three people chased Karandeep on the same morning.

Queue as of today (from Jay's list on the whiteboard):
- Harrington (Dhaval) — $210k, US, their paper — by **1 Oct**
- Lakeshore (Jay) — $64k, US — by **3 Oct**
- BlueOrchid pilot (Jay) — $38k — by **5 Oct**
- Gulf Crown (Bhavin) — $140k, Saudi — by **10 Oct**
- TravelHub (Karandeep) — $52k, Dubai — no date
- Rheinwerk (Bhavin) — €88k, Munich — draft arriving tomorrow, by **15 Oct**
- Sunrise SOW-2 (Dhaval) — $45k — Meera sending this week, wants by **8 Oct**

Discussion:
- Karandeep: reviewing late at night after calls, 10pm onwards. A client-paper MSA takes him 3–4 hrs properly. "Harrington alone is a whole evening and I haven't started."
- Dhaval raised ShopSwift — SOW sat 9 days in July waiting for review, Elena's budget slipped a quarter. "We lost that one to our own queue."
- Volume: Bhavin reckons last year was ~5 contracts/month, this year ~9 (MSAs, SOWs, NDAs, DPAs, amendments). Only Karandeep signs.
- Went through Gulf Crown headline terms. Midway Karandeep stopped: "didn't we sign something with the Dubai hotel people that stops us doing hotels in the Gulf?"
- Nobody could find the Al Noor contract quickly — Dhaval searched the shared drive, not there. Karandeep thinks it's in his email "somewhere".
- Bhavin: "I think that expired, no? It was a 2025 thing." Karandeep not sure.
- Jay: "is there a list of what we've agreed to not do?" — silence.
- Dhaval asked if we should send Harrington to counsel. Karandeep: "it's $210k, but Mehta Rao takes a week." Not decided.
- Bhavin: Gulf Crown can't slip, Faisal has a summit on the 14th.

Karandeep will go through them this weekend.

title: Call with counsel (Mehta Rao): Gulf Crown / Al Noor
text:
# call w/ Priya Menon (Mehta Rao) — Gulf Crown / Al Noor — 25/9
my notes, rough

- walked her thru Gulf Crown — KSA hotels, rev mgmt + guest analytics
- told her abt Al Noor non-compete (from memory — GCC? 18 months after?). she asked for the actual doc. found it in email after 20 min, sent while on call
- she wants EVERY signed contract w/ restrictive covenants, exclusivity, MFN — "I can't advise on one in isolation"
- me: I don't have a list. would have to open each one
- she: then that's the first job
- also asked: which entity signed Al Noor? and does their affiliate definition catch AtliQ Inc? — didn't know offhand. said I'd check
- asked about Oman waiver — does it help? she said "depends what it says, send it"
- fee: ₹1,20,000 for Gulf Crown + Al Noor review
- turnaround 5–7 working days FROM when she has all docs
- 2 Oct holiday. if I send everything by Thu 1st → 9 Oct best case, 13 Oct worst. Faisal wants signed 10th
- she said don't tell client anything firm till she's read it

TODO: dig out contracts — which ones though??

title: Harrington huddle
text:
# Harrington — quick huddle (Sun 27 Sep, call)
Present: Karandeep, Dhaval, Pranav

- Harrington now = 3 docs: NDA (signed Aug), MSA (their paper, in review), BAA (arrived 16 Sep — Rebecca wants it signed together with the MSA). Dhaval: "one more doc for Harrington."
- Pranav: scoping is going well. Kevin Brooks (their data eng manager) emailed a "sample extract" on 12 Sep so we could size the pipeline. Pranav opened it here and forwarded to Sneha and Vikram in Pune to start profiling. "It's real data I think — names, DOBs, some diagnosis codes."
- Dhaval: the BAA says nobody outside the US touches patient data, so he's bringing in Daniel Ortiz, freelance data engineer in Austin. Contractor agreement + NDA drafted on our US template. "US-based, so the offshore thing is solved."
- Karandeep: "Our cyber policy is $1M btw, Harrington BAA wants 5."
- Pranav asked if the CareBridge setup (the intercompany thing) covers this too — Karandeep: "should do, same kind of work." Nobody checked.
- Dhaval: Rebecca needs MSA + BAA by 1 Oct.

Let's talk Monday.
